title: Coding4Games: Can Modern Coding Agents Play Modern Video Games?
abstract: arXiv:2611.31974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Games, especially modern AAA games, challenge language models to perceive complex scenes, control actions, and make decisions over long horizons. Existing game benchmarks primarily test language models as computer-use agents that query a language model throughout play, incurring repeated inference cost and, in real-time games, acting while the environment continues to evolve. We ask whether coding agents can learn from game interaction to develop standalone game-playing programs that run without language model inference. We thus introduce Coding4Games, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can develop standalone programs that play modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs. translated_title: Coding4Games：现代编程智能体能玩现代电子游戏吗？
translated_abstract: 游戏，尤其是现代3A大作，对语言模型提出了挑战：它们需要感知复杂场景、控制动作，并在长时程中做出决策。现有的游戏基准主要将语言模型作为计算机使用智能体来测试，即在整个游玩过程中持续查询语言模型，这会带来反复的推理成本，并且在实时游戏中，智能体需要在环境持续演化的同时采取行动。我们提出一个问题：编程智能体能否从游戏交互中学习，开发出无需语言模型推理即可独立运行的游戏程序？为此，我们提出了Coding4Games，这是一个用于评估编程智能体能否开发出通过视觉观察和标准游戏输入来游玩现代游戏的独立程序的基准。Coding4Games具有三个核心特点：1）多样化的现代游戏，涵盖15款在视觉、策略和控制需求上各不相同的游戏；2）开发与测试分离，即编程智能体使用沙盒和标准玩家界面（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了Coding4Games基准，评估编程智能体能否开发出无需在游玩过程中调用语言模型、仅依靠视觉观察和标准游戏输入就能独立运行并游玩15款多样化现代游戏的程序。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Coding4Games, a benchmark that evaluates whether coding agents can develop standalone programs capable of playing 15 diverse modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs, without requiring language model inference during play.
